legacy_learning_quarantined.title: Learning restarted safely
legacy_learning_quarantined.description: The previous shared learning data for {name} was quarantined once. Rolling and long-term learning restart separately. The effective adaptive Burst threshold may now be lower. Configured thresholds, acknowledgements and confirmed active alarms are preserved. Observe the legitimate maximum flow and set the Burst base with at least 20% safety margin.

mqtt_identical_reports.title: MQTT zero reports may be suppressed
mqtt_identical_reports.description: Flow source {entity_id} does not use force_update. Home Assistant may suppress identical valid MQTT measurements. A single zero value and internal ticks cannot safely reset Low Flow. Set force_update: true in the MQTT sensor/discovery configuration and check expire_after and the explicit source timeout against actual telegram intervals. Missing telegrams never mean zero consumption.

mqtt_measurement_provenance.title: MQTT measurement origin not verified
mqtt_measurement_provenance.description: No new original measurement was verified for {entity_id}. Flow detection is blocked for this message; existing alarms remain active. Preserve the original radio measurement time as a timezone-aware timestamp in the MQTT JSON payload. force_update alone is insufficient. Retained, replayed, late or future packets provide no evidence. Check the MQTT provenance instructions and diagnostic status.

runtime_safety_recovery.title: Safety state requires recovery
runtime_safety_recovery.description: The runtime store for {name} is damaged or contains conflicting alarm identities. Alarm and shutoff requests are conservatively retained; affected acknowledgements and resets are blocked. Preserve the original file, stop Home Assistant and restore a verified complete backup. Do not delete the store to clear an alarm. Then verify sources and diagnostics. The integration does not operate a valve.
